description: Source code for AccessHandlePoolVFS class implementing a custom Virtual File System using the File System Access API with synchronous access handles, tailored for SQLite integration within the Notesnook project.

classes.name: AccessHandlePoolVFS
classes.description: A custom Virtual File System class utilizing the File System Access API with synchronous handles, managing SQLite database files within a specified directory, supporting capacity management and file association.

methods.name: xOpen
methods.description: Opens or creates a file within the VFS, managing access handles and file associations.

methods.name: xClose
methods.description: Closes a file, flushing data and handling deletion if specified.

methods.name: xRead
methods.description: Reads data from a file at a specified offset into a buffer.

methods.name: xWrite
methods.description: Writes data to a file at a specified offset from a buffer.

methods.name: xTruncate
methods.description: Truncates a file to a specified size.

methods.name: xSync
methods.description: Synchronizes file data to storage.

methods.name: xFileSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of a file.

methods.name: xSectorSize
methods.description: Returns the sector size used by the filesystem.

methods.name: xDeviceCharacteristics
methods.description: Returns device characteristics flags.

methods.name: xAccess
methods.description: Checks for the existence of a file.

methods.name: xDelete
methods.description: Deletes a file.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes all access handles and releases resources.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes all files in the managed directory.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Releases and reacquires all access handles, preparing for capacity changes or resets.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the current number of managed SQLite files.

methods.name: getCapacity
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of files the VFS can handle.

methods.name: addCapacity
methods.description: Increases capacity by creating new files and access handles.

methods.name: removeCapacity
methods.description: Decreases capacity by removing and closing access handles.

methods.name: #acquireAccessHandles
methods.description: Enumerates directory files and opens access handles for them.

methods.name: #releaseAccessHandles
methods.description: Closes all access handles and clears internal mappings.

methods.name: #getAssociatedPath
methods.description: Reads and verifies the header to get the associated database path.

methods.name: #setAssociatedPath
methods.description: Sets the header with the database path and flags, updating internal mappings.

methods.name: #computeDigest
methods.description: Computes a simple, synchronous hash digest of the header data.

methods.name: #getPath
methods.description: Converts a filename or URL to a UNIX-style path.

methods.name: #deletePath
methods.description: Removes the association between a path and an OPFS file.
